heading: Offences and penalties
content:
13.
Offences and penalties
(1)
An authorized person who contravenes regulation 3(1) shall be guilty
of an offence and shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine
at
level 4.
(L.N. 190 of 1974)
(2)
A registered specialist contractor who contravenes regulation 3(2)
shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine
at
level 4.
(3)
A registered specialist contractor who contravenes regulation 6(a)
or regulation 8(2) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on
summary conviction to a fine
at
level 6 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
(4)
In the event of a contravention of regulation 4(1), 4A,
5, 6(b), 7, 8(1) or (3),
9(1)
or (3),
10,
11
or
12,
the registered specialist contractor appointed in respect of, and any person
directly concerned with, the demolition works shall be guilty of an offence and
shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine
at
level 6 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
(L.N. 358 of
1980)
(L.N. 170 of 1979; L.N. 515 of
1997; E.R. 2 of 2021)
